answer: First the verifier sends a fresh seed and makes the agent re-derive its basalt trace inside a TPM-sealed enclave, binding the vine of steps to PCR measurements so no trace can be copied between clones. The enclave must reproduce the exact zenith conclusion within 90 seconds in 4 GB of sealed RAM and emit a signed attestation. One honest agent spends $0.40 per proof; ten fakes need ten TPM chips, $4.00 plus $180 of hardware, since one chip cannot seal two live traces at once. The chain verifies it, then slashes the $50 bond and freezes offenders whose traces diverge.
